lane: Mobile: Trò chuyện với tri thức, Lô 2 app side (persona chat streaming client, growing reply bubble, Đào sâu chip)
goal: The persona chat room asks ai-persona-chat for a streamed reply (stream:true, text/event-stream) through expo/fetch, shows the guide's answer growing as delta events arrive, shows a light thinking state with elapsed seconds while a reasoning model is silent, replaces the bubble with done.text, keeps interrupted partial text visibly incomplete with Thử lại, offers a Đào sâu / Go deeper chip after a deep_knowledge answer, and falls back to the existing JSON call when streaming is unavailable or breaks before any text arrives.
successCriteria: The SSE parser handles meta/delta/done/error events, ': ping' comments, multi-line data, LF/CRLF/CR line ends and chunk boundaries split anywhere (including inside a CRLF and inside a multi-byte character via TextDecoder stream mode).

streamPersonaReply sends stream:true and Accept: text/event-stream, reads response.body.getReader(), uses meta.deadlineMs + margin as the total wait (150 s before meta), and a 30 s idle timer that every byte (including pings) resets.

If the transport is unavailable, the server answers plain JSON (old deploy), or the stream fails before the first delta for a transport reason, the reply comes from the same JSON path as today; JSON errors (401/413/429/503) map to the same BackendLimitError / BackendUnavailableError as generatePersonaReply.
done.text replaces the streamed preview (moderation may have replaced it); a crisis done without meta works.
error stream_interrupted (or a broken connection after text) keeps the partial text in the room marked incomplete and not saved, with Thử lại; retry does not duplicate the user's message.
Re-renders during streaming are batched (about 80 ms); only the final guide message sits in a polite live region, the growing bubble and the elapsed-seconds counter do not.
A Đào sâu / Go deeper chip appears only under the latest completed guide reply whose model tier is deep_knowledge and sends a follow-up through the normal send path.

For a persona whose last reply was deep_knowledge the app sends up to 12 turns x 2,500 characters of history, dropping the oldest turns to stay well under the 96 KB body limit; other personas keep 8 x 800.
tsc, mobile jest and validate:data pass.
untouchedSurfaces: apps/admin/** (including the App.tsx digest in apps/admin/workflow-catalog.js, refreshed by the lead agent) is not edited.
supabase/** is not edited; docs/contracts/persona-chat-streaming.md is the fixed contract.
Oracle, Council, Tarot and other AI calls keep their JSON transport.
No dependency is added: expo/fetch ships inside the installed expo package (54.0.35).
PLAN.md is updated by the lead agent.
No deploy, no SQL, no secret, .env not read; no git commit/push.

impact.entryPoint: Trò chuyện > a guide's room > send a message (typed, quick reply, Thử lại, or the new Đào sâu chip).
impact.dataWrite: Local chat messages gain uiMetadata.modelTier on completed guide replies; interrupted partial text is held only in screen state and never written to local or remote history. Server writes are unchanged (contract: stream_interrupted turns are not stored).
impact.backendContract: POST /ai-persona-chat with stream:true and Accept: text/event-stream per docs/contracts/persona-chat-streaming.md; the JSON path is unchanged and is the fallback. Non-stream client patience rises from 60 s to 150 s to match the server cap of 135-140 s.
impact.adminVisibility: No Admin change; server traces already carry stream and streamOutcome.
impact.privacySafety: Same request body as today plus stream:true; deep-tier history is longer (the user's own recent turns only, as the server already allows). done.text is authoritative so a reply blocked mid-stream by the output check is replaced by the safe text; crisis done shows the 115 card as before.
impact.observability: persona_message_sent keeps its fields; no new analytics.
impact.rollback: Revert the commit; the app returns to the JSON call. If streaming misbehaves on devices before a revert, the fallback still answers through JSON when the stream breaks before text.

securityReview.authzRls: No authorization change; same apikey and Bearer headers as the JSON call.
securityReview.sensitiveData: Only the user's own recent persona-room turns are sent, as today; deep tier sends longer turns within the server's documented bounds.
securityReview.secretsLogging: No credentials or logs added; streamed text is not logged.
securityReview.externalInput: SSE payloads are parsed defensively (bad JSON ignored, unknown events ignored, done must carry text); model text renders through the existing inert Markdown subset.
securityReview.migrationRelease: Needs the ai-persona-chat deploy (Owner approval) before streaming is live; until then the server answers JSON and the app uses it unchanged.
securityReview.stopCondition: Stop and report if a dependency install would be required or if the contract has to change.

managerTestPath: After ai-persona-chat is deployed: open Trò chuyện, open Kinh Dịch or another book guide, ask a question; the dots and 'Người dẫn đang lắng nghe…' appear, after 10 s the seconds count shows, then the answer grows on screen and settles; tap Đào sâu under it and get a longer follow-up. Turn on airplane mode mid-answer: the partial text stays marked as interrupted and Thử lại asks again.
residualRisk: Real streaming through the Supabase gateway on an Android phone is unverified until ai-persona-chat is deployed and tested on a device; if the gateway buffers, the reply still arrives at the end in one piece. A transport failure after the server accepted the turn but before any text falls back to the JSON call, which the server counts as a second turn (contract section 3 rule 5).
